sourceArchive.purpose: Read exact Cargo.lock for a complete upstream dependency audit before collecting missing notices.

scope: Complete upstream lock graph checked; runtime requirements conservatively retain every reachable normal/build/optional/platform edge, excluding only proven root dev-only reachability. Exact historical link set is not asserted.

rootManifest.exclusionPolicy: Exclude only packages unreachable after removing root dev-only edges; no target or feature pruning.

missingPackagesScope: Metadata for 16 new exact versions; hashbrown 0.17.0 is dev-only in the upstream graph. Existing declaration-only wasm-metadata 0.244.0 is also dev-only and is not a runtime notice requirement.
